posts.text: Congrats to Ohio’s leaders, including my running mate, for bringing an economic wave to our state. It’s the beginning of a new dawn & I’ll ensure it translates to high-paying jobs & wealth creation in every part of Ohio. It’s also worth noting that we surpassed states like VA & NC over the last year which floundered due to anti-business policies from newly elected Democrat governors. We cannot & will not let that happen in Ohio.

posts.text: This is another awful reminder of the risks that our police officers face every day. I spoke to an officer from the area this afternoon to let him know we’re ready to help in any way to maximally protect our men & women in blue. They’re dealing with a lot in Wayne County right now, and our hearts go out to them. In the meantime, let’s pray for the family of Sgt. Scott Ries and for the recovery of the injured officers.
